verdict.rationale: Pandoc is operated through explicit command-line flags such as -f/--from and -t/--to, plus a Haskell library, Lua filters and an HTTP server mode. Nothing in the evidence shows a natural-language command interface. A conversion tool could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies, but no capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
